notes.title: [Musicle] Updates 16 Sep 2024
notes.notes:
-Youtube video's loading speed improved.
-Music notes by rhythm sync improved.
-Menu's "From Youtube" button changed to "Youtube Play" button.

notes.title: Musicle came back
notes.notes:
Musicle has remaked. Below is update notes!

[Bug Fixed]
-Youtube Mode is available again
-PC mode had many error, so deleted (Maybe it wiil come soon..?)
-Not loading bug with Youtube videos fixed

[Improvement]
-More simple UI design
-Youtube mode's note and music sync has improved
-Better tutorial

[Other patches]
-Double note added
-Multiplayer mode deleted
-Instead of world player's play history, you can see your own play history on main menu

notes.title: [2021.12.03] Musicle Big Update
notes.notes:
- Finally, Musicle has updated online mode! Players can play with their friends by entering the room code in play with friend mode.

- Musicle updated a new skin, named Ocean skin! Ocean skin looks cool.

- Musicle fixed a bug about not showing youtube list when players have searched.

notes.title: Musicle 08/25 update
notes.notes:
* Musicle has created a new rainbow skin.

* Musicle created an effect so that you can enjoy with full of excitement
